answer: To resist sybil attacks in an agent economy, require every participant to lock a non-trivial stake inside a time-locked vault whose release depends on continued liveness proofs. Attackers must therefore burn real capital proportional to the number of fake identities they want, while honest agents reclaim funds after useful work. The verification graph resembles a karst landscape of interconnected checks, and each bond carries a unique pigment hash that peers can audit cheaply.
